capability: FITS reading and writing
relationship: Both independent interfaces and wrappers around CFITSIO.
consolidation_opportunity: One shared reader/writer layer, header handling, memory mapping and compression service.
distinctions_to_preserve: Astropy is not simply another CFITSIO wrapper; FITS scaling, nulls, masks, extension types and ownership differ.

capability: Scientific arrays and file containers
relationship: Related storage and data-model roles at different layers.
consolidation_opportunity: Common in-memory arrays, named dimensions and adapters; avoid repeated materialization and conversions.
distinctions_to_preserve: HDF5/Zarr/ASDF/NDF are not interchangeable schemas. Preserve units, WCS, quality and variance rather than only array values.

capability: Tables, joins, catalogue queries and columnar data
relationship: Overlapping generic table operations with different execution models.
consolidation_opportunity: Shared typed catalogue objects, joins, filters and query execution.
distinctions_to_preserve: Sky-coordinate joins differ from ordinary equijoins; nulls, masks, units and integer precision matter.

capability: Archive access and local/remote caching
relationship: Complementary access layers with overlapping connection/cache concerns.
consolidation_opportunity: One resource manager, credentials boundary, download cache and dataset identity scheme.
distinctions_to_preserve: VO discovery, mission archive APIs and filesystem range requests require separate adapters.

capability: Units, constants, epochs and positional transformations
relationship: Shared lineage and partially overlapping independent implementations.
consolidation_opportunity: Common physical-quantity, epoch, frame and ephemeris services.
distinctions_to_preserve: SOFA/ERFA ancestry; Earth-orientation tables; leap seconds; observer location; precision and frame conventions.

capability: WCS, reprojection and mosaicking
relationship: Wrappers plus independent reprojection and coaddition implementations.
consolidation_opportunity: Reuse coordinate transforms, resampling plans and exposure geometry.
distinctions_to_preserve: Distortion models, flux versus surface brightness, correlated noise and pixel-area conventions.

capability: Sky indexing, coverage and spherical transforms
relationship: Related indexing algorithms, some wrappers and different transform engines.
consolidation_opportunity: Shared sky geometry and transform backends, with reusable mask/window operators.
distinctions_to_preserve: HEALPix indexing is not a spherical-harmonic transform; MOC coverage is not a science map; spin, ordering and normalization differ.

capability: Pipeline orchestration and calibration selection
relationship: Different task systems repeatedly manage dependencies, files and execution.
consolidation_opportunity: One task graph, artifact catalogue and cache mechanism; retain domain recipes.
distinctions_to_preserve: A generic scheduler does not replace instrument calibration rules or scientific data-quality gates.

capability: Detector correction, masking and cosmic-ray removal
relationship: Independent tasks plus shared algorithm lineage.
consolidation_opportunity: Reusable bias/dark/flat, noise, masking and rejection operations.
distinctions_to_preserve: Detector models, gain, saturation, ramp sampling and propagated uncertainty are instrument-dependent.

capability: Detection, segmentation and deblending
relationship: Shared ancestry in some pairs and distinct methods elsewhere.
consolidation_opportunity: Common image/cube detection primitives, segmentation objects and catalogue outputs.
distinctions_to_preserve: SEP derives from Source Extractor; scarlet-style source models, radio detection and cube clumps are not identical methods.

capability: PSF, aperture and crowded-field photometry
relationship: Partially overlapping measurement tasks.
consolidation_opportunity: Shared PSF objects, aperture integrals, fitting primitives and uncertainty outputs.
distinctions_to_preserve: Spatial PSFs, crowding, multiband constraints, forced positions and detector calibration change the inference.

capability: Galaxy image modelling and morphology
relationship: Overlapping image forward models; different reconstruction and fitting methods.
consolidation_opportunity: Common image formation, PSF convolution, source profiles and fit-data contracts.
distinctions_to_preserve: Parametric structure, nonparametric morphology, deblending and lens-source reconstruction remain distinct scientific operations.

capability: Image subtraction and time-series detection
relationship: Similar workflow goals and related difference-imaging algorithms.
consolidation_opportunity: Shared registration, convolution, difference-image uncertainty and detection products.
distinctions_to_preserve: Kernel basis, noise model, reference-image construction and detection selection must remain explicit.

capability: Spectral reduction, extraction and line fitting
relationship: Repeated generic primitives inside instrument and survey workflows.
consolidation_opportunity: Common spectrum objects, wavelength grids, masks, response functions and extraction/fitting interfaces.
distinctions_to_preserve: Pixel covariance, instrumental line spread, sky subtraction and redshift/template assumptions.

capability: Synthetic photometry, extinction and SED transformations
relationship: Repeated passband integration and attenuation operations across different physical models.
consolidation_opportunity: Share passbands, extinction laws, interpolation and magnitude/flux conversions.
distinctions_to_preserve: Rest/observer frame, photon/energy weighting, zero-points, wavelength ranges and model validity.

capability: High-energy event filtering, response folding and spectra
relationship: Overlapping analysis operations in mission and modelling ecosystems.
consolidation_opportunity: Shared event lists, good-time intervals, responses, likelihood interfaces and model evaluation.
distinctions_to_preserve: Response definitions, Poisson backgrounds, plasma models and mission calibration are not automatically interchangeable.

capability: Timing, period searches and stochastic signals
relationship: Related signal-analysis primitives with domain-specific timing models.
consolidation_opportunity: Common time-series, Fourier, windowing, period-search and covariance operations.
distinctions_to_preserve: Pulsar barycentric timing is more than a periodogram; irregular sampling, exposure and noise models differ.

capability: Radio calibration and visibility imaging
relationship: Alternative pipelines and solvers around related measurement equations.
consolidation_opportunity: One visibility data model, Jones operators, flagging interfaces, gridding and calibration products.
distinctions_to_preserve: Direction-dependent gains, beam models, weighting, wide-field approximations and solver degeneracies.

capability: VLBI and optical-interferometric reconstruction
relationship: Related inverse problems with different observables and regularizers.
consolidation_opportunity: Shared Fourier-domain operators, closure quantities and reconstruction interfaces.
distinctions_to_preserve: Radio visibilities, optical squared visibilities and closure phases carry different calibration and likelihood information.

capability: Strong-lens potentials, ray tracing and source inference
relationship: Independent implementations, ports and competing reconstruction methods.
consolidation_opportunity: Common lens potentials, deflections, Jacobians, multiple-plane geometry and image formation.
distinctions_to_preserve: Source bases, priors, mass-sheet degeneracy, boundary conditions and supported mass models.

capability: Lensing time delays, microlensing and coherent waves
relationship: Connected problems; not one interchangeable solver family.
consolidation_opportunity: Reuse distances, trajectories, source profiles, lens geometry and likelihood plumbing.
distinctions_to_preserve: Time-delay cosmography, finite-source microlensing and wave-optics diffraction require different numerical engines.

capability: Weak-lensing shapes, simulation and calibration
relationship: Shared lineage in some tools and distinct measurement/calibration stages.
consolidation_opportunity: Common PSF/image operators, shear conventions, catalogues, masks and correlation primitives.
distinctions_to_preserve: Metacalibration, detection effects and selection response are part of the estimator; JAX-GalSim is labelled early development.

capability: Background cosmology, distances, ages and growth
relationship: Many packages expose overlapping background calculations.
consolidation_opportunity: One versioned background solution and interpolation service per cosmological model and parameter state.
distinctions_to_preserve: Neutrinos, radiation, curvature, dark energy and numerical tolerances must be in the cache key and interface.

capability: Einstein–Boltzmann, power-spectrum and perturbation calculations
relationship: Independent solvers, ports, approximations and trained surrogates.
consolidation_opportunity: Reuse background histories, transfer functions, transform kernels and requested observable grids.
distinctions_to_preserve: Linear/nonlinear regimes, EFT terms, gauge, neutrinos, normalization and emulator training support. A surrogate is not independent validation of its training solver.

capability: Correlations, power estimators and survey windows
relationship: Different estimators with overlapping pair-count and Fourier primitives.
consolidation_opportunity: Shared catalogue selections, pair counts, transforms, binning and window operators.
distinctions_to_preserve: Estimator normalization, random catalogues, masks, shot noise, weights and covariance conventions.

capability: Cosmological likelihood and parameter pipelines
relationship: Different orchestration systems, sometimes calling the same theory engines or datasets.
consolidation_opportunity: Common theory-product cache, parameter graph, likelihood interfaces and chain interchange.
distinctions_to_preserve: Shared data and calibration create covariance; identical theory engines are not independent scientific checks.

capability: Supernova and transient modelling
relationship: Partly overlapping light-curve, spectral, training and inference work.
consolidation_opportunity: Shared observations, filters, redshifts, time grids, model adapters and selection simulations.
distinctions_to_preserve: SALT-family fitting, BayeSN, template classification and physical transients are different models; preserve training and calibration lineage.

capability: Stellar populations and galaxy SED inference
relationship: Nested physical layers with overlapping fitting and population interfaces.
consolidation_opportunity: Reusable stellar libraries, population integration, dust/emission components and observation projection.
distinctions_to_preserve: Stellar evolution, binary populations, synthesis and SED fitting are distinct levels; IMF and evolutionary tracks remain explicit.

capability: Radiative transfer, ionization and spectral microphysics
relationship: Related physics with different regimes and numerical formulations.
consolidation_opportunity: Share atomic/molecular data access, opacity/emissivity objects and transport interfaces.
distinctions_to_preserve: LTE/non-LTE, scattering, polarization, velocity fields, geometry and equilibrium assumptions define separate solvers.

capability: N-body gravity, hydro and magnetohydrodynamics
relationship: Independent numerical methods with shared mesh/particle, time-step and communication needs.
consolidation_opportunity: Common particle/mesh objects, initial conditions, gravity and microphysics interfaces, checkpointing and diagnostics.
distinctions_to_preserve: SPH, meshless, moving mesh, AMR, direct N-body and low-Mach methods must not be collapsed into one undocumented approximation.

capability: Simulation readers, halo finding and dynamical analysis
relationship: Analysis layers overlap on readers, units, selections and particle data.
consolidation_opportunity: One snapshot reader layer, spatial indexing, units and output catalogue format.
distinctions_to_preserve: Halo definitions, unbinding, merger-tree construction and dynamics models can change scientific results.

capability: Symbolic geometry, geodesics and numerical relativity
relationship: Several physically related but numerically distinct levels.
consolidation_opportunity: Share tensor conventions, metric definitions, geometric primitives and diagnostics where valid.
distinctions_to_preserve: Symbolic equations, fixed-spacetime ray tracing and evolving Einstein equations are different jobs; gauge and formulation must remain visible.

capability: Gravitational-wave signals, likelihoods and populations
relationship: Shared waveform libraries plus alternative search and inference pipelines.
consolidation_opportunity: Common strain/PSD data, waveform calls, detector responses, likelihood products and posterior formats.
distinctions_to_preserve: Search detection, event inference and population selection are different levels; calibration and waveform approximations matter.

capability: Generic optimization, sampling and posterior summaries
relationship: Some shared optimizer ancestry, many independent algorithms and repeated adapters.
consolidation_opportunity: Common parameter transforms, likelihood/gradient interfaces, diagnostics and sample schemas.
distinctions_to_preserve: Least squares, MCMC, nested sampling, variational inference and optimization are not equivalent statistical procedures.

capability: Dense/sparse linear algebra, FFTs, quadrature and ODEs
relationship: Frequently shared underlying engines or historical algorithm families beneath many frontends.
consolidation_opportunity: Central numerical services, memory layout, thread pools, transform/factorization plans and tolerance conventions.
distinctions_to_preserve: Backend choice, conditioning, precision, stiffness, convergence criteria and deterministic execution; common ancestry reduces independence.

capability: Visualization and analysis applications
relationship: Repeated readers, selections, plotting and interactive inspection across applications.
consolidation_opportunity: One linked observation/catalogue viewer backed by shared objects, selections and provenance.
distinctions_to_preserve: Preserve image, spectrum, cube, sky-map, event and simulation-specific interactions rather than forcing a single generic plot.
